clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Raleigh Andrean lives among the Forsaken. His requests show how little regard he has for his human life and those he once knew.

Before the Third War, Raleigh Andrean lived in Lordaeron as a human. He was married to Deliah and counted Valdred Moray as a friend. The Scourge swept through the kingdom, killing Raleigh and raising him as a mindless thrall in service to the Lich King. After the Lich King's grip shattered and Sylvanas Windrunner led her uprising, Raleigh regained his free will and joined the Forsaken in the Undercity.
